D12.clean_flag_rate_max: reject or unsure on at most 20 percent
D12.defect_recall: reject or unsure on at least 90 percent of labelled defective plans, and on every blocker-severity entry
D12.minimum_validation_size: at least 15 defective and 15 clean held-out plans, supplemented with seeded-defect plans reported as synthetic; if the minimum cannot be met the reviewer is not validated
D12.run_agreement_min: identical verdicts on at least 90 percent of plans across two runs
D12.sample_rate: 1 in 10 in steady state; 100 percent through the pilot (WP-4.2, WP-4.3)
D12.scope_of_authority: per defect class: only classes with measured recall; others advisory
D12.suspension: the owner overturns any blocker-class pass, or more than 1 in 5 of the last 10 sampled passes (at least 5 sampled)
